scope: ui.hub.skills.*: download, unpull, unpull_title, unpull_body, unpull_failed, subscribe_failed, local_path, published_by, not_downloaded, subscribed_absent, pulled, manual, detached (13 keys) audited against English ui.hub.json

findings.note: Gender disagreement inside one label. The noun is "compétence" (feminine) and the file agrees feminine everywhere else ("Non téléchargée", "Téléchargée", "Installée dans", "Publiée par"); "Abonné" is masculine (or the masculine noun "subscriber"), so "Abonné — non installée" contradicts itself.
Same gender inconsistency: the first half is feminine, the second masculine. "Abonnée" agrees with "compétence".

French typography: 20 strings in the fr catalogues use a narrow no-break space (U+202F) before "?"; this one uses a plain space, which is inconsistent and also allows a line break before the question mark.

findings.current: Les fichiers quittent votre dossier de compétences. Le lien et son abonnement restent, donc un nouveau téléchargement rétablit la révision actuelle.
findings.proposed: Les fichiers sont retirés de votre dossier de compétences. Le lien et son abonnement restent, donc un nouveau téléchargement rétablit la révision actuelle.
findings.note: Word-for-word rendering of "leave": "quitter" is anthropomorphic for files and reads translated in a confirmation body; "sont retirés de" is the idiomatic UI phrasing.
